title: Cascade Ortho Rider Payment Schedule Table
content:
Orthodontic Benefit Riders pay a case benefit as an initial payment followed by installments. The terms that set the shape of that payment schedule differ by rider as follows.

| Rider | Initial payment (percent of case benefit, new-start case at banding) | Installment frequency | Installment months cap | First installment begins (months after the banding month, or after the establishment month for a takeover) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | 25 | quarterly | 24 | 3 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | 25 | quarterly | 24 | 3 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | 30 | monthly | 24 | 1 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | 25 | quarterly | 24 | 3 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | 30 | monthly | 30 | 1 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | 35 | monthly | 30 | 1 |

## Terms the same on every rider

| Term | Value on all six riders |
|---|---|
| Lump-sum limit | 6 months: a new-start case whose planned treatment months are at most 6 is paid as one payment at banding, the initial payment being the whole case benefit, with no installments |
| Installment issue day | day 1 of the month, each installment being issued on that day for its service period |
| Rounding | installment amounts are rounded half up to the cent, and the last installment absorbs the rounding remainder |
| Installments per case and service period | at most 1 |
| Active rider requirement | each installment is payable only if the rider is active on the first day of its service period |
| Payee, in-network payments | the practice |
| Payee, out-of-network payments | the member (the practice only with an assignment of benefits on file) |

### Reading the cap

Installments are spread over the planned treatment months after the banding month, but never over more months than the installments months cap.

*Hypothetical example:* a case planned for 33 months on a rider with a 30-month cap has 32 months after the banding month. That is limited to 30, which gives 30 monthly installments on a monthly rider. On a quarterly rider with a 24-month cap, the same case would have its 32 months limited to 24, giving 8 quarterly installments.
